name: Listen before you solve
audience: Partners who want to listen more attentively
hypothesis: A specific listening prompt earns more saves than a broad relationship promise.
caption: Sometimes support starts with one question: Do you want me to listen, help, or give you some space? Tune Into Her offers one respectful daily cue. Follow this page for launch updates.

name: Small things count
hypothesis: Concrete everyday actions drive more profile visits than abstract messaging.
caption: Check the plan. Share a task. Ask what would help. Small, welcome actions can make care visible. Tune Into Her brings one thoughtful cue into your day. Follow for launch updates.

name: Context without assumptions
hypothesis: Explaining the product’s limits builds trust and qualified interest.
caption: Cycle timing can offer approximate context. It cannot explain a person or predict their mood. Tune Into Her combines a simple estimate with a respectful daily cue. Use only information your partner agrees to share. Follow for launch updates.
slides:

not a personality.

Experiences differ between people and cycles.

Shared information should stay a shared choice.

Use the cue
to start listening.
Her own words matter more than the estimate.

Context. Care.
A conversation.

name: A quieter kind of app
audience: People who value privacy and simple tools
hypothesis: Local cycle storage and a restrained experience improve qualified interest.
